old_problem: RAM1~N conflicts with one tuple, the split command has no approved continuation, correctable criteria conflict with reset, and SATA/USB settings plus target-specific evidence/recovery are unexplained.
disposition_reason: Enumeration values may be runtime parameters, but the vendor definition of RAM targets, split invocation and severity/reset behavior are core semantics. test_case.test_name: USB RAM target-matrix fault and controller/device recovery
test_case.purpose: For every approved RAM1~N target, run one authoritative USB RAS stimulus, verify the signed severity/reset and fresh target-specific evidence, and restore controller, port and attached-device service before another target.
required_package: Vendor definition of USB RAM1~N and listvalidusb fields
Approved one-line/continued usbsata syntax and errortype-usb semantics
Correctable-versus-reset policy and target-specific persistent fields
Independent OOB, safe-device exclusions and per-target recovery/rollback
test_case.test_command: Do not join or execute the split command. After approval, enumerate and bind one non-critical target, capture raw settings and device/service baseline, run one exact vendor invocation once under OOB capture, correlate fresh source/severity/reset evidence, then restore and validate the controller/port/device before another target.
test_case.expected_result: Each authorized physical target produces the approved event/reset branch and one fresh target-specific record; host, controller, port and device recover within deadlines with no filesystem/service impact and exact setting restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until range, syntax and severity are authoritative. One hardcoded tuple, guessed command join, generic USB text, wrong target, unexpected reset, boot/input/network/storage loss or incomplete restoration fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT with OOB independent of tested USB paths.
Never target boot, management or active storage/input/network functions without an approved isolated substitute.
One mapped target once; abort on ambiguous enumeration, wrong device, reset anomaly or service/data impact.
expected_evidence: Full USB RAM physical matrix and vendor syntax contract
test_case.recovery: Cover missing/unexpected reset, boot/device recovery and exact SATA RAS/USB ECC SMI/BIOS/HDT restoration per target. Execution remains blocked until all target branches are approved.
